question: Choose the correct sentence using reported speech. [LGD-26]
options: He said that he will submit the drawing the next day.
He said that he would submit the drawing the next day.
He said that he would submit the drawing tomorrow.
He said that he will submit the drawing tomorrow.
explanation: Reporting speech past tense হলে Reported speech অনুরূপ Past tense হয়। তাহলে would submit হবে এবং tommorrow পরিবর্তিত হয়ে the next day হবে। সুতরাং, সঠিক উত্তর হবে (খ)।
correct_answer: He said that he would submit the drawing the next day.

question: Identify the correct indirect speech : He said, "I am busy." [BWDB-26]
options: He said he was busy
He said he is busy
He says he was busy
He said that I am busy
explanation: এখানে সবগুলো option অশুদ্ধ। শুদ্ধ বাক্যটি হতে পারতো 'He said that he was busy' কিন্তু option-গুলোতে এ ধরনের কোনো বাক্য নেই।

question: Choose the indirect speech of "She asked, 'Do you like music?'" [WZPDCL-26]
options: She asked if I liked music
She asked did I liked music
She asked I liked music
She asked whether do I like music
explanation: এখানে She asked if I liked music বাক্যটি সঠিক। Reported speech, Present Indefinite হলে Indirect narration Past Indefinite হয়।
correct_answer: She asked if I liked music

question: He said, "You are a fool." (to indirect speech) [GDA-25]
options: He said that you are a fool
He said that I was a fool
He called me a fool
He said that the man was a fool
explanation: 'He said that I was a fool বাক্যটি সঠিক; কারণ Reported speech এর Verb Present Indefinite হলে Indirect Narration-এ Past Indefinite হয়ে যায়।
correct_answer: He said that I was a fool

question: We asked him why he– telephoned earlier. [MOE-2023]
options: did not
had not
has not
was not
explanation: Indirect narration-এ reporting verb Past Indefinite হলে reported speech Past Perfect Tense হবে। সুতরাং had not হবে।

question: Change the form of narration : The teacher said "Honesty is the best policy." [MOE-2023]
options: The teacher said that honesty is the best policy.
The teacher said that honesty was the best policy.
The teacher said that honesty had been the best policy
The teacher said that honesty should be the best policy.
explanation: Direct narration চিরন্তন সত্য বুঝালে Indirect narration-এ Tense-এর কোনো পরিবর্তন হয় না। সুতরাং সঠিক উত্তর হবে 'The teacher said that honesty is the best policy.'
correct_answer: The teacher said that honesty is the best policy.

question: Choose the indirect speech of the sentence : She said to him, 'Thank you'. [BPSC-2023]
options: She told him to thank you.
She thanked him.
She thanked you.
She said to him to thank you.
explanation: এখানে Indirect speech হবে। She thanked him. Reported speech-এ Thank you থাকলে Indirect Narration এ Thank হয়।

question: Choose the correct indirect speech. He remarked, 'Two and two makes four'. [BPSC-2022]
options: He remarked that two and two would make four
He remarked that two and two made four
He remarked that two and two makes four
He remarked that two and two make four
explanation: Option (গ) 'He remarked that two and two makes four.' সঠিক উত্তর। Direct Speech-এর reported speech টি 'Universal truth' হলে তা indirect speech এ unchanged থাকে।
correct_answer: He remarked that two and two makes four

question: He said to me, "Thank you". [DPHE-2016; MOCA-2020]
options: He thanked me.
He had thanked me.
He told me that thank you.
He wished a thank to me.
explanation: Direct Narration-এ Thank you/Thanks থাকলে Indirect narration-এ said এর পরিবর্তে thanked বসবে। তাই He thanked me সঠিক।

question: What will be the indirect form of the following sentences? He said "I am well". [MOCA-2019]
options: He said that I was well.
He said that he is well.
He said that he was well.
He said that I am well.
explanation: Principal clause-এর verb-এর tense অনুসারে Subordinate clause-এর verb হয়। তাই Subordinate clause-এর 'am' was হবে।
correct_answer: He said that he was well.

question: I said to him, "Is he a doctor?" Turn the sentence into indirect speech. [HED-2019]
options: I said to him that he was a doctor.
I said to him whether he is a doctor.
I asked him whether he is a doctor.
I asked him whether he was a doctor.
explanation: Interrogative sentence-এ direct speech-কে indirect speech-এ পরিণত করতে said to-এর পরিবর্তে asked-কে আনতে হয়। weather-এর পরবর্তী অংশ past tense হবে।
correct_answer: I asked him whether he was a doctor.

question: The indirect speech of the sentence "Sally said to me, \"Please get me a drink\"". is– [HED-2018]
options: Sally told me to get a drink for her.
Sally asked me to get her a drink.
Sally told me to get a drink.
Sally inquired me to have a drink for her.
explanation: Imperative sentence-কে Direct speech থেকে Indirect speech-এ পরিণত করতে হলে Please থাকলে তার verb-এর পূর্বে to বসিয়ে Indirect করতে হয়।
correct_answer: Sally told me to get a drink for her.

question: Choose the direct speech of the sentence : She told us to hurry up. [PWD-2015]
options: She said, "Do hurry up".
She said to us, "Hurry up".
She told, "hurry up".
She said us, "hurry up".
explanation: Indirect speech-এ told থাকলে direct speech-এ said to বসে।

question: He said to me, "May Allah bless you". [MODMR-2006]
options: He wished that Allah might bless him.
He wished to me that Allah might bless him.
He wished that Allah might bless me.
He prayed that Allah might bless him.
explanation: Reporting speech-এর verb past tense হলে এবং Reported speech-এর verb present tense হলে তা past tense-এ রূপান্তরিত হয়। এর Optative sentence-এ Say/said হলে Indirect-এ wish বসবে।
correct_answer: He wished that Allah might bless me.
